notes: LT-03.4a finite BatchState/OutcomeState/OutcomeReasonCode oracle. Every Batch, BatchSummary, Outcome and BatchPage is literal data bound to the frozen queue_selections selections and the complete rule_expectations rule/RuleSet/target definitions. The three accepted LT-03.3b preflight scenarios (PF-DIRECT-FRESH, PF-PREVIEWED-FRESH, PF-SAME-USER-NEW-SESSION) receive real Batch payloads; an isolated heterogeneous accepted selection without the NOT_READY member covers the remaining outcome kinds. The module cross-checks counts, attempts, placements, pagination, inventory expectations and reason/state consistency without implementing a matcher, priority resolver, executor or filesystem writer. Each batch is an independent finite scenario universe; the physical inventory contract is a logical expectation, not measured filesystem evidence.

batches.reason: PF-DIRECT-FRESH returns an ACCEPTED durable batch: the whole 120-item plan is durably fixed but no file has been touched yet; page 1 of 100 PENDING outcomes plus the 20-item page 2 describe the exact frozen membership.

PF-PREVIEWED-FRESH partial RUNNING batch: 118 NO_SCENARIO files are already moved to the flat manual review folder while one PENDING and one PROCESSING outcome remain; page 1 is full at the 100-row limit and page 2 carries the remaining 20 rows.
PF-SAME-USER-NEW-SESSION finishes as COMPLETED_WITH_ISSUES: all three EXPLICIT off-page items have no scenario and are moved to the flat manual review folder with their unchanged basenames.

Isolated heterogeneous accepted selection without the NOT_READY member: two safe renames, one NO_SCENARIO manual review, an occupied target, a duplicate plan target with no winner and an occupied manual review name. The post-acceptance source-change outcome is a separate SKIPPED scenario in batch-atlas-technical.
Equal-priority RULE_CONFLICT moves the file to the flat manual review folder with the unchanged basename; it is not quarantine and no rule wins.
All three safe renames succeed: COMPLETED means every outcome is SORTED and every source is gone from incoming.

Technical failure batch: one confirmed quarantine move, three per-file skips that perform no own mutation, and two unfinished RECOVERY_REQUIRED outcomes (unknown placement actual_location=null versus a known source whose quarantine was unavailable). The batch stays unfinished and is not terminal.

duplicate_targets.reason: Two selected files plan the same still-free canonical path. Every participant is REQUIRES_DECISION/TARGET_OCCUPIED; processing order selects no winner.

occupied_targets.reason: The existing target is never overwritten; the source stays in incoming.

manual_review_occupied.reason: The flat manual review folder already holds the source basename; no suffix, replacement or subfolder is created.

inventory.note: No file is written or read by this fixture. Content tags are deterministic logical labels derived only from the declared tag prefix and the item id; they are not measured filesystem hashes and must not be presented as proof. The inventory records only describe what a conforming backend must preserve or leave untouched.

content_recipe.description: The content tag is the literal tag_prefix + item_id label; it is a deterministic logical marker, not bytes or a measured hash.

mutations.reason: A batch with recovery_required outcomes must keep status RECOVERY_REQUIRED.
completed_count must equal the first five outcome counters.
completed_count must not exceed selected_count.
A COMPLETED batch must carry finished_at.
A RECOVERY_REQUIRED batch stays unfinished.
An ACCEPTED batch must not report completed outcomes.
BatchState is a closed enum.
SORTED requires a confirmed actual_location.
The planned target must equal the selected rule directory + stem + last suffix.
A confirmed SORTED move must land exactly on its planned target.
Manual review has no predicted target; only the actual flat destination is resolved.
Manual review preserves the full original basename.
REQUIRES_DECISION keeps the source in place.
A missing source must not report a location.
An unfinished RECOVERY_REQUIRED outcome must keep finished_at=null.
Every duplicate-plan-target participant must stay REQUIRES_DECISION; no order winner.
The first page of a batch above the page limit must be full.
Every outcome must belong to the frozen selection membership.
The outcome revision must match the frozen selection revision.
History is ordered created_at DESC, batch_id DESC.
Declared counts must agree with the materialized outcomes.
A confirmed move must not leave the source in incoming.
Attempt ids are unique.
